fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Water-Column + Air-Chamber Dynamics with Wells Turbine
source: Falcao & Henriques (2016), Renewable Energy 85, 1391-1424 (OWC review); Evans (1978), J. Fluid Mech. 77, 1-25; Sarmento & Falcao (1985), J. Fluid Mech. 150, 467-485

unit.name: Generic shoreline/fixed OWC chamber with Wells air turbine (~ Pico/LIMPET scale)

S_wc.note: Internal water-column free-surface plan area (chamber cross-section)

b_owc.note: Width of OWC front opening facing the incident wave crest

depth_lip.note: Submergence / effective water-column length scale for inertia

V_chamber.note: Mean air-chamber volume above water column (compressibility)

B_rad.note: Hydrodynamic radiation damping coeff. of the OWC piston mode (Evans 1978)

C_turb.note: Wells turbine pneumatic admittance: flow per unit chamber pressure (linear damping)

K_wells.note: Wells turbine non-dimensional power coefficient (peak before stall)

phi_stall.note: Wells turbine flow coefficient at aerodynamic stall

eta_turb_peak.note: Peak Wells turbine aerodynamic efficiency (Falcao & Henriques 2016)
